name: Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce
author: Nashir Uddin

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce store with the Product Video Gallery plugin, designed to showcase your products with engaging videos. This powerful plugin allows you to integrate stunning video galleries directly into your product pages, boosting user engagement and increasing conversions.

Supported Video Types

  1. YouTube Videos: Supports YouTube videos for easy integration.
  2. HTML5 Videos: Supports MP4, WebM, and OGG formats for flexibility and performance.
  3. Embed Videos: Supports YouTube,PeerTube,Vimeo and other embed videos for easy integration.

How to use Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce plugin – Video Tutorial

Key Features

  1. Preload Video: Load videos efficiently to enhance the browsing experience.
  2. Playback Speed Control: Allow users to adjust video speed as per their preference.
  3. Autoplay & Muted: Automatically play videos with or without sound for a seamless experience.
  4. Loop Videos: Keep your videos playing continuously to maintain user attention.
  5. Reset on End: Automatically reset the video to the beginning after it ends.
  6. Enable Smooth Seeking: Provide a smooth navigation experience for seeking within videos.
  7. Playsinline: Optimize playback for mobile devices by preventing fullscreen switching.
  8. Big Play Button: Highlight the play button for easy user interaction.
  9. Progress Control Bar: Let users track video progress effortlessly.
  10. Remaining Time Display: Show how much time is left in the video.
  11. Display Negative Time: Enable the option to show negative time for a unique countdown view.
  12. Volume Control: Offer full control over video volume.
  13. Fullscreen Toggle: Allow users to enjoy videos in fullscreen mode.
  14. Thumbnail Position: Bottom, left and right thumbnail position option.
  15. Image Position: Image gap option between thumbnail and slider image.
  16. Thumbnail Image Round: Thumbnail Image Round option.
  17. Thumbnail Image Numbers: Thumbnail Image numbers option.
  18. Thumbnail Navigation: Thumbnail Navigation button and arrow color picker option.
  19. Theme Compatibility: Compatible with most popular themes like Astra, OceanWP, Storefront, Kadence, Hestia, Estore, Sydney, Neve ect.

Why Choose This Plugin?

  1. Super fast: WooCommerce default slider used, No third party JS libery. So it is fast and does not load any extra JS libery.
  2. User-Friendly Interface: Simple to configure and customize.
  3. Optimized for Performance: Lightweight and built to ensure fast loading times.
  4. Responsive Design: Fully compatible with all devices and screen sizes.

Boost Conversions with Engaging Product Videos

Transform your WooCommerce store by showcasing your products with videos that captivate and convert. Whether you use YouTube or HTML5 formats, this plugin offers everything you need to elevate your product pages.

Start using Product Video Gallery for WooCommerce today and create a more dynamic shopping experience for your customers!

JS Libraries Used

The Third party libraries, non-compiled version of JavaScript and/or CSS-related documentation and source code can be found at the following links:

  1. assets/js/product-video-gallery-for-wc-videojs.js: For the creation of Video Player. Documentation, Source Code
  2. assets/js/product-video-gallery-for-wc-youtube.min.js: For the display of Youtube Video. Source Code

Support

For support, feature requests, or any inquiries, please email at nashirbabu@gmail.com
sections.installation:
1. Choose to add a new plugin, then click upload
  2. Upload the product-video-gallery-for-wc zip
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
